title: Carlina Compass v1 capture annotation relation
description: Owner-scoped immutable evidence topology for already committed Compass captures. The authenticated client gateway derives owner and device scope; request bodies never supply those identities. This additive contract does not alter the frozen capture detail schema.

Rfc3339Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit UTC designator or numeric offset.

CaptureRelationKind.description: A text or voice annotation capture attached to a screenshot capture.

CaptureRelationCreateRequest.description: Creates an immutable directed relation. The parent must be a committed screenshot; the child must be a committed text or voice capture in the same owner scope.

outcome.description: created means this request established the relation; existing means a concurrent or prior request had already established the same immutable semantic relation.

CaptureRelationDirection.description: The requested capture's role in this directed relation.

CaptureRelationDiscovery.description: All owner-visible immutable relations in which captureId is either the parent or child. Attachment bytes and capture content are intentionally not included.
